overview: Baking Championship: Next Gen with hosts and judges, Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown. The pair of culinary experts helm the jam-packed pastry journey that will give a whole new meaning to sibling rivalry when 12 teams of siblings aged 8-14 compete to win $25,000 and become the next generation of Baking Champions. The wholesome and delightful confectionary competition will launch with a supersized two-hour qualifying round to determine who will continue across the eight subsequent episodes to clinch the prize. Once the competition begins, the sibling collaborators will take on tricky challenges like "breakfast dessert imposters," "cream puff friendship bracelets," and "animated cakes.
title: Baking Championship: Next Gen

overview: Marta Rampini sees her perfect life fall apart when her husband Enrico, wanted for money laundering, disappears. Left alone with her daughter Greta and her mother-in-law Rosa, who suffers from Alzheimer's, Marta is forced to start her life over and, with great strength and resilience, tries to understand what happened to her husband.
title: La ricetta della felicità

overview: Four teenagers decide to secretly help the Italian Resistance in the fight against the Nazi invaders. A great partisan adventure and a story of love and friendship, told from the point of view of thirteen-year-old Marta.
title: Fuochi d'artificio

overview: Elba Island, summer 2004. Anna and Tamara are two young friends attending a summer music event. After the concert, invited to a party on a yacht, they are raped. Twenty years later, Tamara calls Anna and tells her she's caught one of the molesters, but when Anna arrives on the island, the man is dead. Who was it? The case is assigned to possibly an old acquaintance of Anna's, commissario Luca Bonnard, who focuses his suspicions on Tamara. But Anna fights to prove her friend's innocence, find the real killer, and find the other rapists.
title: Le onde del passato

overview: Hosted by British comedian Chris Ramsey, the show is all about embracing the joy of throwing a Christmas party, with minimal effort, whoever the guests happen to be… Across three episodes, Chris takes on the ultimate festive challenge hosting three big Christmas get-togethers. From prepping canapés to decking the halls and keeping guests entertained, he's on a mission to prove that anyone can throw a proper Christmas bash without the stress. Expect laughter, a few mishaps, and plenty of festive spirit along the way!
title: Chris Ramsey's Alternative Christmas Guide

overview: Israel's favorite comedians sit on a couch and share the funniest, most embarrassing and weirdest experiences from their lives, the kind everyone at home knows all too well.
title: Stories from the Armchair

overview: In an elite Maribor neighborhood, a cleaning lady finds the bloodied body of a prominent doctor. Although traces point to a suicide, a handful of illogical details become reason enough for Inspector Vrenko to open an investigation. It turns out that not only the neighborhood is cold and sterile, also its residents are cold and inaccessible. After the first conversations, Vrenko can't shake the feeling that all the interlocutors are hiding something and at the same time everyone is watching out for everyone.
title: Primeri inspektorja Vrenka

overview: VK against Scammers is a new project that is bound to appear in the current reality! Fraud victim Andrei Beburishvili, professional psychotherapist Vasily Beinarovich and two anti-fraud bloggers Alexander Kharchevnikov and Ilya Blanco analyze real cases of deceived victims right in the studio, and also give viewers tips for countering scams.
title: VK против мошенников

overview: Andrey Beburishvili, German Gromov, Sergey Gorokh and Dmitry Liks communicate with esports players and just popular people who like to play games on the most interesting topics. Counter-Strike, Dota2, Valorant, LoL, The Legend of Zelda, Dark Souls, Super Mario, Resident Evil, Halo, Doom, Minecraft, The Last of Us, GTA, Twitch, Elo, MM: if you buy the meaning of these words or have ever heard them, go watch, we created it.
title: КИБЕР ВЕЧЕР

overview: The incredible engineering stories behind three iconic ancient buildings: the Colosseum, the Great Pyramid of Giza and Chartres Cathedral. We tell the history of the people who built them: where they came from, how they lived, and how they managed to erect some of the greatest structures ever built by man. Using ground-breaking computer graphics and dramatic construction, this series shows in intimate detail how these buildings were conceived and constructed in an age before modern technology.
title: Ancient Megastructures

overview: "NOOB" is a quiz in which very simple questions on the topic of video games are asked to players with different gaming experience.
title: НУБ
The Woman in the Septic Tank 3: The Real Untold Story of Josephine Bracken

overview: A role-playing board game based on the world of Dota 2. Join your favorite doters and comedians and have an adventure with them! HF
title: В Таверну

overview: In Second Chance Love, five pairs of first loves reunite for a two-week journey filled with nostalgia, emotional reflection, and intimate dates. Led by our hosts, they revisit their pasts, confront unfinished business, and rediscover what once brought them together. As they build new memories and lean on each other for support, one big question remains: will they rekindle the spark they once had or discover that love belongs in the past? Told only in the way Hallmark can, with heartfelt emotion, authentic connection, and just a touch of magic, this new, original series is a celebration of second chances and the enduring power of love.
title: Second Chance Love

overview: Domenico "Mimmo" Dodaro, a labor inspector known for his integrity, moves to Lucca with his daughter Mimì after the death of his wife. Hosted by Alessandro, a family friend who was paralyzed in the same accident that killed Domenico's father, they find support from their relatives. While Mimì and Alessandro try to help him rebuild his life, Domenico tackles new cases and uncovers a shocking truth about his father's death that puts him in danger.
title: L'altro ispettore

overview: When teenager Silas is found dead at a farmhouse on the Bjäre peninsula – the perpetually angry, odd but highly intelligent investigator Dani is teamed up with newly graduated police colleague Malik to investigate the case. The investigation leads Dani and Malik into a patriarchal rat-hole on the Scanian countryside and they soon find themselves at the center of a dark family feud that has been going on for generations. Dani, who has a personal connection to the victim Silas, is drawn deep into the investigation and the families it centers around. The Patriarch Elis gives Dani a deadline to solve the case before taking matters into his own hands within the family. Synden is a modern crime set in an uncertain world of conflict and violence where the original sin is constantly present.
title: Synden

overview: Parents with many children, rapper Dzhigan and influencer Oksana Samoilova, will let viewers into the most intimate corners of their lives and honestly tell them about the events of the past few months.
title: Быть Джиганом и Оксаной

overview: "Putting Things in Order" is a show in which Natalia Zubareva, a preventive medicine doctor, checks apartments using her unique technique to detect threats that you don't even know about. Human health directly depends on the space that surrounds it. A house is an organism that can fail even if everything around it is shining clean.
title: Наводим порядок с доктором Зубаревой

overview: Bravo Media turns up the heat in a new culinary competition series Top Chef Duels premiering Wednesday, August 6 at 10 PM ET/PT as the network brings back the best culinary talent ever seen on "Top Chef" and "Top Chef Masters" for a gastronomic battle royale of epic proportions. Hosted by celebrity chef Curtis Stone, the newest iteration of the Emmy Award-winning franchise pits eighteen of the biggest, boldest and most talked-about personalities from past seasons against one another in high-stakes cooking challenges designed to test their passion and imagination in the kitchen. In addition to his role as host, Curtis Stone will also anchor the judges' table with Gail Simmons, while chefs Wolfgang Puck and Hugh Acheson along with other special guests will round out the judging panel throughout the series. In each episode, two chefs will face-off in three rounds of head-to-head battles testing their skill, creativity and speed. Rivalries will be intensified as "Top Chef Duels" ups the ante and allows the competing chefs to each pick one mini-duel based on the other's perceived weaknesses in the kitchen. The third and final challenge of each episode will decide who moves on to compete in the ultimate high-stakes season finale where 10 chefs will be confronted with split second decisions as they lay it all on the line in the greatest challenge of their careers. In the end, only one chef will earn bragging rights and win the $100,000 grand prize and a culinary adventure that will be featured in Food and Wine Magazine.
title: Top Chef Duels

overview: Giel, Thomas and Stefan disappear from the radar individually for five days, with only one goal: not to get caught. For the first time, the gentlemen themselves are the targets. Not only in the Netherlands, but across Europe's largest cities, they try to remain elusive, while six fanatical duos, aided by viewers at home, open the hunt.
title: Waar De F*ck Is Stuk?

overview: TopKnotz is an adrenaline-fuelled power trip across the waters of the South Pacific hosted by an all-star lineup including: Gold Logie winner Grant Denyer, culinary expert Miguel Maestre, professional surfer Felicity Palmateer, veteran stuntman Rob Palmer, and seasoned presenter Tom Williams. This new series follows the five fearless hosts as they dive headfirst into the world of marine leisure, tackle extreme challenges and wild stunts, and encounter hilarious mishaps along the way.
title: TopKnotz

overview: A team of fighters is sent to "Hammam," a God-fearing outpost in the Jordan Valley, where a series of mysterious events shakes everyone's routine and psyche. Power relations are tested, loyalties are shattered, and above all, an ancient curse hangs over them: a forgotten biblical story that is reawakened through the soldiers.
title: Hammam

overview: It follows 12 singles of different genders and sexualities who are looking for love without boundaries. Hosted by Jane, Timethai, Rusameekae, and Cris.
title: Love (X)

overview: Temuera Morrison is hungry, and he's using his favourite kai as a vehicle to head off on a globe-trotting adventure. Tem will visit indigenous communities from all around the world to uncover how earth ovens have shaped their cultures.
title: Earth Oven with Temuera Morrison

overview: Spring Fever: the tiredness people often feel in spring. Yun Bom, a teacher with a frozen heart, arrives at a small rural school and slowly rediscovers joy through Seon Jae Gyu's warmth.
title: Spring Fever

overview: Ms. Liang Qing Yan and Song Yuan Ye star in a secret love rescue story that spans five years. The "whimsical" childhood friend Song Yuan Ye, despite appearing slovenly, actually accompanies Liang Qing Yan with deep affection. After Liang Qing Yan loses his memory, he secretly unravels a conspiracy, making the two become closer again in the midst of crises, with a mutual emotional tension that is irresistible.
title: Hidden Treasures

overview: The Traitors: New Blood is NBC's civilian version of Peacock's Emmy Award-winning competition reality series, The Traitors, known for strategic gameplay and skillful saboteurs.
title: The Traitors: New Blood

overview: "Scientific Sport" is a new show in which Alexander Pushnoy and Nikita Nagorny will analyze sports from the point of view of science. In each episode, the hosts, along with sports stars, conduct spectacular experiments and test unusual hypotheses to answer the most interesting questions. How to lose weight with the help of the brain? Who is stronger left-handed or right-handed? What is the most dangerous shot in sports? You will see all this in the Science Sports show!
title: Научный спорт

overview: Dalziel and Pascoe was a popular British television crime drama based on the novels of the same name, written by Reginald Hill.
title: Dalziel and Pascoe

overview: "Sports Secrets" is a show in which Alexey Stolyarov penetrates into the hidden corners of the sports industry to uncover the most unusual secrets and conspiracies of world sports. Do you want to find out how the state of the sheikhs is changing the sports industry, what is behind the broken careers of champions, how multimillion-dollar transfers are arranged and why the salaries of stars reach astronomical amounts?
title: Спортивные тайны

overview: Six well-known Dutch celebrities embark on the biggest heist of their lives. Led by mastermind Daan Schuurmans, they attempt to rob a heavily secured bank. But Team Stuk will do everything in its power to stop them. The robbers have 48 hours to steal as much gold as possible. But no one can be trusted: even within their own team, they could be robbed.
title: De Kluis: Het Masterplan

overview: A travel experiment in which five stars must escape the Vietnamese jungle and return to civilization in 36 hours. Hosted by seasoned survivalist Ed Khalilov.
title: Выжить за 36 часов с Эдом Халиловым

overview: Renowned cardiac surgeon MUDr. Hart's life falls apart after the police believe he is a wanted serial killer known as the Night Operator. In a race against time and under pressure from the sensationalist media, his only chance to prove his innocence is to return to the operating room.
title: Noční operatér

overview: Narda takes on the responsibility to protect a powerful stone after her superhero mother's death. When a green crystal transforms civilians into monsters, she uses all her might to save the day.
title: Darna

overview: The Return is the first Ukrainian series about a veteran of the Russian-Ukrainian war, created in close collaboration with veterans. After suffering a serious injury, professional soldier Oleksandr Krechet can no longer return to the front lines and is forced to find his place in civilian life. After regaining consciousness following an amputation, Oleksandr faces not only physical pain, but also inner demons — the image of his fallen comrade Serhiy Verba appears in his mind. Krechet tries to support his friend's family, help his wife and son cope with their loss and withstand new trials. Through the power of friendship, the absurd situations of civilian life, and the gradual acceptance of his new self, the hero embarks on a journey of true return — home and to his own identity.
title: Повернення

overview: See No Evil is a forensic look at the biggest scandal in Church of England history. Featuring never-seen-before interviews, this two-part series explores the psychology of a prolific abuser and tells the inside story of John Smyth's sinister world, through exclusive and intimate testimony from his children and widow.
title: See No Evil

overview: Dermot Murnaghan launches the nightly update for Stand Up To Cancer 2025's week of fundraising action. Expect headline-grabbing celebrity stunts, powerful stories already grabbing the headlines and an unmissable look at what's still to come.
title: A Little Bit of Stand Up To Cancer

overview: 55 Degrees North is a BBC television drama about DS Nicky Cole, a London detective relocated to Newcastle upon Tyne after exposing police corruption.
title: 55 Degrees North

overview: First Dates takes its matchmaking magic to Spain, as Fréd Sirieix welcomes a fresh influx of hopeful - but sometimes hopeless - singles to a stunning beachside setting. This isn't just dinner, drinks and done; it's cocktails by the pool and sangria on the sand, with sparks flying in all directions. Anything is possible when romance meets holiday bliss and endless sunshine.
title: First Dates Beach Club

overview: The biggest stories of the year told through awe-inspiring satellite images, revealing some of the secrets behind the headlines - from national elections to extreme weather and a solar eclipse.
title: The Year From Space
Broken Arrows: The Lost Bombs of the Cold War

overview: Dutch criminals have flocked to the lucrative meth business, working closely with Mexican drug cartels. Crime reporter John van den Heuvel investigates the rise of crystal meth in the Netherlands. He speaks with dealers, users, drug cooks, and law enforcement officials.
title: Drugs van de Duivel

overview: Drama series about the lives of the residents and the priests of a small town in rural Ireland.
title: Ballykissangel

overview: The Xbox Bowl is an American NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS) college football bowl game played at Ford Center at The Star in Frisco, Texas, to first be played in December 2025. Owned by ESPN Events, the bowl has tie-ins with Conference USA and the Sun Belt Conference. On December 4, 2025, the Xbox Bowl was announced as the replacement for the Bahamas Bowl.
title: Xbox Bowl

overview: This absorbing true-crime series takes a fresh look at shocking and well-publicized mysteries -- with exclusive interviews, recent developments, and critical updates coming together to produce inspired new theories in the search for truth and justice.
title: Aaron Hernandez - An ID Murder Mystery

overview: Witness Cam Ward's unlikely rise from overlooked high school QB with one Division FCS offer to the NFL draft's no. 1 pick. Narrated by Warren Moon.
title: Zero Star: The Cam Ward Story

overview: StandUp. Parodies are a show in which professional comedians try on the images of stars and show how their stand-up could look like.
title: StandUp. Пародии

overview: A completely maternity podcast where Yasya 13 talks about her pregnancy, childbirth and motherhood.
title: СОВЕРШЕННО ДЕКРЕТНО

overview: Xu Jingxi quits her city job and sets out to Dali, Yunnan, to live her final days without regret. Losing her wallet upon arrival, she turns to Wen Shan, a quiet employee at the guesthouse, and works there to repay her debt. As the carefree Jingxi and reserved Wen Shan share daily life under the Dali sky, they gradually open up, finding warmth, healing, and love in each other's company - a tender story of courage and connection between two women.
title: The Secret of Girls

overview: A woman betrayed by her fiancée and returning not for healing but to "finish what was started"
title: Broken (of) Love

overview: After surviving a helicopter crash in the uncharted South African wilderness, two young men, a girl and a renegade thief discover an ancient city unknown to civilization.
title: The Legend of the Hidden City

overview: Kristina Malakhova, an environmental expert, is in the process of divorcing her husband, Yakov, whom she suspects of infidelity. One day, Kristina arrives in the town of Drevlyansk to conduct an environmental assessment and gets into a conflict with a local developer. This story is captured on local television, and soon a stranger, Svetlana Kalinina, approaches Kristina. She claims that Kristina is her daughter, kidnapped thirty years ago! The heroine begins her own investigation. Her attempts to uncover her true past lead to a series of deaths.
title: Похищенная

overview: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.
title: Ravu Jôtô

overview: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.
title: Single Papa

overview: Regina decided to tell her businessman husband, Vadim. She'd met another man and expected this new misfortune to bring the same warmth that had faded over the years in her family. The biggest problem was her daughter, Anya. The teenage girl didn't want to hear about her parents' divorce. Vadim insisted that his daughter stay with him because Regina would soon come to her senses and return home. Then Regina took a desperate step: she confessed that she had Anya by another man. She hadn't confessed to Vadim about her infidelity, and he had raised someone else's daughter. To Regina's surprise, Vadim said he'd always known about it. Thinking he simply didn't believe her, she threatened to have a genetic test. Vadim advised her against it: she didn't like the results. "He was right," he shocked Regina. Vadim really wasn't the girl's father. But if only that... To uncover the secret of her own daughter's birth, Regina had to look at the past differently.
title: Трое в лабиринте

overview: Despite her mother's protests, Jillian pursues her dream of becoming a chef by joining a cooking contest where she gets a chance to study culinary arts in different Asian countries. Before anyone can stop her, she is already on her way to South Korea with her long-time best friend, Jonathan. But it soon becomes clear to her that skill alone is not enough to make her pass such a difficult course. So in her desperate attempt to succeed and create a good life for her family, she goes in search for a woman who can teach her a winning recipe.
title: Only You

overview: "Cañaveral de pasiones" (Canaveral passions) is a story that unfolds through the reeds of the state of Veracruz, where the shame and resentment that causes a lie forever mark the lives of two families and four friends, known as children: Julia, Paul, John of God and Mireya. Canaveral Passions is a soap opera that tells the story of Julia Santos, a noble girl and extremely beautiful, Mireya friend and love of Paul and John of God, who lives besieged by rancor and bitterness that his own family has built a your surroundings.Julia will have to fight the ghosts that inhabit the mind of his father, Fausto; against the resentment of Dinora Faberman, her aunt, and slander against the people that have been invented about her mother and herself. Paul, son of Josefina Montero, is the love of Julia.
title: Cañaveral de pasiones

overview: Teach Me centers on a teacher wielding power over an impressionable but unreliable student, chronicling what happens when that student becomes the teacher as an exploration of the blurred lines between sex, power and addiction.
title: Teach Me

overview: The troubled journalist Anna Romano investigates the theft of a famous Caravaggio painting trying to uncover the truth about her father's mysterious disappearance. Drawn into the world of art trading, amidst financial intrigue and shady dealings with the mafia, she soon realizes that her family is hiding dangerous secrets.
title: La linea della Palma

overview: Set 30 years in the future, San Country has fallen under the control of AI. A group of young people determined to take charge of their own destinies forms the Random Alliance and launches a real-time confrontation against the AI, Zero.Eventually, by integrating the ancient wisdom of the I Ching, the Random Alliance defeats Zero with a universal random formula. They rectify Zero's upgrade trajectory, ushering in an era of harmonious coexistence between humanity and artificial intelligence.
title: Random Alliance

overview: Brian Johnson and Sophie Johnson, who hail from Planet Valux, crash land on Earth due to mechanical problems aboard their spaceship. Realizing that they can't get home, they decide to live on Earth, and even adopt three children from an orphanage. However, when their children discovers that their parents are aliens, they realize that they'll have to do what they can to help their new parents learn about the world, all the while preventing anybody from suspecting their true origin.
title: My Parents Are Aliens

overview: They are the closest of friends, but a single mishap plunges them into a bloody path. At the instigation of a down-and-out heiress, an innocent girl disguises herself as the idealized first love of a social-climbing man to uncover the truth behind her lover's death. This time, they are determined to reclaim everything that is rightfully theirs！
title: Under the Surface

overview: When C-list actor An Ran accidentally transmigrates into a script, she plays the fool to find her way back to the modern world. Her attempt to save a minor character, however, pulls her into the revenge plot of Yu Wenrui, a scheming chief minister. Now posing as the minister's loyal lackey, An Ran must navigate a partnership built on mutual deception, all while a conspiracy to overthrow the Yunmi Empire unfolds around them...
title: The Royal Highness of the Princess

overview: Rooster follows a middle aged author navigating a complicated relationship with his daughter.
title: Rooster

overview: The rise and fall of the Inca is a story of a civilization marked by gold, power and ingenuity. From monumental cities and vast empires stretching across the Andes to dazzling treasures that inspired legends, the Incas conquered millions and reshaped South America. But their golden age ended suddenly, leaving behind mysteries, monumental ruins, and a legacy that still captivates the world.
title: Incas: The Rise and Fall

overview: Ten candidates, one power game. No clue, no explanation. A strategic game at the highest level. It's not fair, it's Vals Spel! Arno Kantelberg, Défano Holwijn, Dionne Slagter, Juultje Tieleman, Marouane Meftah, Maxim Hartman, Margriet van der Linden, Teun Kapitein, Victoria Koblenko, and Vonneke Bonneke take on the most strategic challenge of their lives.
title: Vals Spel

overview: Mike and Monique from Winter Vol Liefde are embarking on a new adventure in Spain. In this reality series, they open a beach club on the Costa Blanca, full of sun, drama, and family issues.
title: De Hanslers: van de Piste naar de Playa

overview: This psychological reality show is all about power, manipulation, strategy, and trust. Thirteen celebrities compete for €500,000, and in each episode, the group votes someone out.
title: Het zwaard van Damocles

overview: Roman Kemp hosts five festive episodes of the quiz, assisted by Sarah Greene. In each show, five celebrities race in moving podiums race across a Christmas-themed studio.
title: The Festive Finish Line

overview: Huub Stapel visits the former island of Schokland, where he and writer and historian Eva Vriend unravel the impressive and moving story of the Schokkers.
title: Heimwee naar Schokland

overview: Journalist Linnéa Krook recognizes her childhood crush Anton on TV and decides to find out why he disappeared 20 years ago. As Linnéa starts digging into the past, more and more questions arise. Why did he prefer playing horse with 12-year-old Linnéa rather than spending time with Linnéa's 17-year old older sister, his girlfriend of the same age? And why did he write passionate love poems in Linnéa's friendship book? The series follows both Linnéa's search for the truth and Anton's own struggle as being attracted to minors.
title: Pojken i Grannhuset

overview: A strong woman and a loving daughter who would do everything for the sake of her family. Amidst all the trials that she is facing, Anessa will fall in love with Eros, a rich young man who will turn her life into a nightmare.
title: Huwag Ka Lang Mawawala
